title: Naked100 Freebase E-Liquid – Maui 30ml
description:
Description
Naked100 presents one of the tastiest tropical blends you’ve ever tried, with a sweet, tangy, and juicy golden Pineapple balanced by the smooth and citrusy duo of ripe Orange and sweet Tangerines. Perfectly balanced with big flavor and exceptional smoothness, Maui Sun will be your new all year vape.
70% VG 30% PG
